cli.description: X-Port — extract from chat archives (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Claude Code, our graph, text files). Zero network by default; sources are never modified.
cli.opt.aggregate: aggregate mode: counts only, no titles, text or file names
cli.opt.sources: archives, directories or files (format sniffed from content)
cli.opt.package: package directory to write (inventory, timeline, selection, manifest, report)
cli.opt.save_recipe: save the normalised recipe to a file
cli.opt.terms: keywords (PL inflection and diacritic folding; /regex/ is a regex)
cli.opt.criteria: criteria: preset id (e.g. chatadhd) or JSON file
cli.opt.like: more like this: similarity to the given units
cli.opt.expand: neighbourhood: none | window:N | branch | conversation | conversation+linked | time_window:P
cli.opt.cascade: cascade: default | recall_first | precision_first | lexical_only | vectors_only
cli.opt.mode: how to combine with the current selection
cli.opt.since: previous export or package: compute the diff (what is new)
cli.opt.only: restrict the selection to the diff result (only_new | changed | removed | all)
cli.opt.model: enable model levels of the cascade (this slice: count and estimate only, no calls)
cli.opt.key: timeline key: created | updated | first_message | last_message | activity
cli.opt.gap: gap in days (0 = do not report)
cli.opt.burst: burst: multiple of the median (0 = do not report)
cli.opt.anonymise: relative axis: gaps kept, epoch zeroed
cli.opt.no_continuations: do not look for cross-service continuations
cli.opt.unit: unit identifier (uid, its prefix or the external id)
cli.opt.files: files to sniff (without files: list known formats)
cli.verb.inventory: Inventory: what the archives contain (measured, never guessed)
cli.verb.timeline: Global timeline across all archives and services
cli.verb.diff: Diff: what is new since the previous export
cli.verb.search: Search and select: words, regexes, criteria, expressions, patterns, similarity; dry run or to a package
cli.verb.explain: Explain why a unit was included or not
cli.verb.mark: Manual decision (stored in decisions.json; wins over the cascade)
cli.verb.clusters: Discover topic clusters (other small projects) without a model
cli.verb.formats: Known formats or recognition of the given files
cli.inventory.absent: What the formats do not contain: {n} entries (inventory.json → absent)
cli.search.model_note: model levels counted, not called (no network); calls arrive in slice B
cli.search.dry: Would include: conversations {conversations}, messages {messages}, attachments {attachments} (missing {missing}), ~{tokens} tokens, ~{bytes} B
cli.mark.usage: Give a UID and a decision (include | exclude | ambiguous | remove), or --list, or --proposals SOURCES
cli.mark.proposals: Proposals: {n} (from {corrections} corrections) — stored in decisions.json → proposals; nothing applied
report.title: Extract report (X-Port)
report.shadow: Shadow channel: lexical only {lexical_only}, vectors only {vectors_only}, both {both}
report.timeline_line: Key {key}: {rows} rows; gaps {gaps}, bursts {bursts}, cross-service continuations {continuations} (inferred, not merged)
report.unknown_blocks: unknown blocks: {n} ({kinds}) — kept in the 'unknown' bucket with an example
report.absent: What the formats do not contain
report.model_pending: Model levels waiting (grains): {flows} — enable explicitly (--model), cost shown before sending
report.how_to_resolve: How to resolve: `mark --decisions decisions.json UID include|exclude` or `--model`.
report.edits_none: nothing — batch edits arrive in slice B
report.reproduce_line: `recipe run recipe.json` from this package ({steps} steps); `manifest.json` → reproducible_hash.
